tools.name: cbam_resolve
tools.description: Calculate EU Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (Reg (EU) 2023/956) embedded direct and indirect emissions, the Art. 31 free allocation adjustment (CBAM factor times the Reg (EU) 2025/2620 CBAM benchmark), required CBAM certificates, and total euro cost for an imported product given CN code, country

tools.name: cbam_scope
tools.description: Check whether a Combined Nomenclature (CN) code falls within Annex I of Regulation (EU) 2023/956, and inspect sector coverage, direct/indirect rules, or child sub-headings.

tools.name: cbam_certificate_price
tools.description: Get the latest published European Commission CBAM certificate price based on European Energy Exchange (EEX) EU ETS auction averages.

tools.name: cbam_defaults
tools.description: Search the European Commission default emission values dataset under Regulation (EU) 2025/2621 as corrected by Regulation (EU) 2026/1740 by CN code prefix, country of origin, or sector.

tools.name: cbam_changes
tools.description: Retrieve the CBAM Data dataset change feed tracking amendments and updates to Annex I scope and default emissions benchmarks.

tools.name: cbam_status
tools.description: Retrieve the active CBAM dataset version, build date, total scope and default rows, and latest price period.
